title: Wear OS bug aaps 3.0.0.1
symptom: The watch face displays only readings that it received at real time. If you set a watch face, you should press 'resend all data' on wear tab of phone app to see your graph for past few hours. If the watch disconnects from the phone for 30 min at night, there is a 30 min gap in the readings which doesn't really exist.
fix: The issue is fixed in the dev branch of the wear OS app. The user can update just the watch app to the dev branch while keeping the phone app on release 3.0.0.1.
evidence_quote: there are many improvements on the wear os app now available on de dev branch. Including fixes for the issue you describe.
